newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares press on amid corporate result storm.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares press on amid corporate result storm.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Wednesday pressed up by the flood of half-year corporate results, with dealers uncertain about the way the market would go in the coming days.

"Turnover has been good despite the fact that there have been technical problems with the trading system. Tomorrow will be steered by two key results from A.P.Moeller and Tele Danmark but it is hard to see how things will go," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.26 point up at 120.03 while the KFX September future finished 0.30 pont higher at 120.30 with nine contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Top insurer Tryg-Baltica dominated the afternoon, its lower first-half 1996 profit not preventing it from rising. The share shot up seven crowns to 300 on the result, falling back to close seven up at 293.
ISS drew interest after announcing its intention to sell off its troubled U.S. ISS Inc unit, the share rising 12 crowns initially but ending eight crowns up at 139 in 610,000 volume.
Sophus Berendsen finished four up at 720 and Tele Danmark two crowns higher at 278 on the eve of their first-half results. Overall turnover was 940 million crowns.
